display.purpose: Algorithm name in the hero state. Used once per screen at most.

title.purpose: Section headers, card titles, the workhorse text role.

body.purpose: Description banners, code-trace body, paragraph copy.

label.purpose: Pills, chips, status text, density-bound micro labels.

shadows.name: no-shadow
shadows.purpose: The system is flat-by-default. Cards convey depth through tonal layering, not box-shadow.

shadows.name: ambient-glow
shadows.purpose: The single ambient pulse divider between the canvas and the code trace. Cyan @ 20%.

shadows.name: cell-glow
shadows.purpose: The cell glow halo while mirroring the active code-trace line. 14dp radius.

motion.name: panelSpring
motion.purpose: Expanding / collapsing panels (theory drawer, segmented toggle resize). 600ms ceiling.

motion.name: cellTravelSpring
motion.purpose: Cell 'pop up, shift, settle' travel during a swap.

motion.name: evalSpring
motion.purpose: Cell 'being evaluated' 1.1–1.2x pop. Hover, compare, found.

motion.name: pointerSpring
motion.purpose: Pointer badge hop between slots (pivot / min / max chase).

motion.name: lineTrackSpring
motion.purpose: The sliding active-line pill in the code trace, synced to the canvas step.

motion.name: liftSpring
motion.purpose: Swap-arc lift phase: pop straight up off the slot.

motion.name: settleSpring
motion.purpose: Swap-arc settle phase: descend into the destination slot.

motion.name: slider-tween
motion.purpose: The fastest perceptible animation in the app — scrubber drag tracking.

components.name: RailIconButton
components.description: The only icon button. Circular, tokenized, owns its own disabled-alpha.
components.html: <button class="ds-rail-icon-button" aria-label="Play"><svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z" fill="currentColor"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-rail-icon-button { width: var(--icon-button-md, 32px); height: var(--icon-button-md, 32px); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0; background: var(--colors-glass-fill, #0C1526); color: var(--colors-text-secondary, #94A3B8); border: 1px solid var(--colors-border-subtle, rgba(255,255,255,0.06)); border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-rail-icon-button:hover { background: var(--colors-glass-elevated, #111D30); border-color: var(--colors-border-medium, rgba(255,255,255,0.10)); color: var(--colors-text-primary, #E2E8F0); } .ds-rail-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--colors-traversal-cyan, #00E5FF); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-rail-icon-button[aria-disabled="true"] { opacity: 0.38; pointer-events: none; } .ds-rail-icon-button .ds-icon { width: var(--inline-icon-md, 14px); height: var(--inline-icon-md, 14px); } .ds-rail-icon-button--primary { width: var(--icon-button-lg, 36px); height: var(--icon-button-lg, 36px); } .ds-rail-icon-button--primary .ds-icon { width: var(--inline-icon-lg, 18px); height: var(--inline-icon-lg, 18px); }

components.name: IconPillButton
components.description: Inline status pill — leading icon + label on a paired accent container.
components.css: .ds-icon-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-2, 4px); padding: var(--space-2, 4px) var(--space-4, 8px); background: var(--colors-cyan-fill, rgba(0,229,255,0.12)); color: var(--colors-traversal-cyan, #00E5FF); border: 1px solid rgba(0,229,255,0.30); border-radius: var(--rounded-xs, 4px); cursor: pointer; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 7.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12px; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-icon-pill:hover { background: rgba(0,229,255,0.18); border-color: rgba(0,229,255,0.45); } .ds-icon-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--colors-traversal-cyan, #00E5FF); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon-pill .ds-icon { width: 11px; height: 11px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-icon-pill .ds-label { white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: SegmentedToggle
components.description: 2+ option switch. One sliding accent pill; unselected options are transparent + muted text.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; gap: var(--space-1, 2px); padding: var(--space-1, 2px); background: var(--colors-glass-fill, #0C1526); border: 1px solid var(--colors-border-subtle, rgba(255,255,255,0.06)); border-radius: var(--rounded-sm, 8px); } .ds-segmented__option { padding: var(--space-2, 4px) var(--space-4, 8px); background: transparent; color: var(--colors-text-muted, #64748B); border: none; border-radius: var(--rounded-xs, 4px); cursor: pointer; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12px; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1; transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease, font-weight 0.2s ease; } .ds-segmented__option:hover { color: var(--colors-text-secondary, #94A3B8); } .ds-segmented__option--active { background: var(--colors-traversal-cyan, #00E5FF); color: var(--colors-workspace-surface, #0B0F19); font-weight: 700; } .ds-segmented__option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--colors-traversal-cyan, #00E5FF); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: GlassCard
components.description: Default card / panel. Tonal layer; no shadow. The depth signal is hue + border + subtle fill.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--colors-glass-fill, #0C1526); border: 1px solid var(--colors-border-subtle, rgba(255,255,255,0.06)); border-radius: var(--rounded-md, 12px); padding: var(--space-6, 16px); } .ds-card--elevated { background: var(--colors-glass-elevated, #111D30); } .ds-card--hero { border-radius: var(--rounded-xl, 24px); padding: var(--space-7, 24px); } .ds-card--selected { border-color: var(--colors-border-cyan, rgba(0,229,255,0.22)); } .ds-card__header { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--colors-text-muted, #64748B); margin-bottom: var(--space-4, 8px); } .ds-card__body { color: var(--colors-text-primary, #E2E8F0); }

components.name: Cell
components.description: 1D renderer cell. The state-to-color mapping is a red line — update one place only.
components.css: .ds-cell { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-1, 2px); min-width: 36px; min-height: 44px; padding: var(--space-2, 4px) var(--space-3, 6px); background: var(--colors-bar-unsorted, #1A2E50); color: var(--colors-text-primary, #E2E8F0); border: 1px solid var(--colors-border-subtle, rgba(255,255,255,0.06)); border-radius: var(--rounded-xs, 4px); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); } .ds-cell__index { font-size: 7.5px; color: var(--colors-text-muted, #64748B); } .ds-cell__value { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-cell[data-state="IDLE"]      { background: var(--colors-bar-unsorted, #1A2E50); } .ds-cell[data-state="COMPARING"] { background: var(--colors-pivot-yellow, #FFB800); color: var(--colors-workspace-surface, #0B0F19); border-color: var(--colors-pivot-yellow, #FFB800); transform: scale(1.12); } .ds-cell[data-state="SWAPPING"]  { background: var(--colors-warn-red, #FF4B4B); color: var(--colors-workspace-surface, #0B0F19); border-color: var(--colors-warn-red, #FF4B4B); } .ds-cell[data-state="SORTED"]    { background: var(--colors-traversal-cyan, #00E5FF); color: var(--colors-workspace-surface, #0B0F19); border-color: var(--colors-traversal-cyan, #00E5FF); } .ds-cell[data-state="PIVOT"]     { background: var(--colors-tracking-purple, #8B5CF6); color: var(--colors-workspace-surface, #0B0F19); border-color: var(--colors-tracking-purple, #8B5CF6); } .ds-cell[data-state="FOUND"]     { background: var(--colors-verified-green, #00E676); color: var(--colors-workspace-surface, #0B0F19); border-color: var(--colors-verified-green, #00E676); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0, 230, 118, 0.40); }

components.name: BottomNavBar
components.description: Five-target bottom navigation. Honors the 48dp Material floor; active target is cyan.
components.html: HomeExplore
components.css: .ds-bottom-nav { display: flex; height: 48px; background: var(--colors-glass-elevated, #111D30); border-top: 1px solid var(--colors-border-subtle, rgba(255,255,255,0.06)); } .ds-bottom-nav__target { flex: 1; display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; min-height: 48px; color: var(--colors-text-muted, #64748B); opacity: 0.6; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08px; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-bottom-nav__target:hover { color: var(--colors-text-secondary, #94A3B8); opacity: 0.9; } .ds-bottom-nav__target--active { color: var(--colors-traversal-cyan, #00E5FF); opacity: 1; border-top: 1px solid var(--colors-traversal-cyan, #00E5FF); } .ds-bottom-nav__target .ds-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-bottom-nav__target:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--colors-traversal-cyan, #00E5FF); outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview:
AlgoLens opens the way a developer opens their editor: same monospace, same accent grammar, same transport controls, no marketing chrome. The user is treated as someone who already lives in an IDE — the canvas is the work surface, the code trace is the spec sheet next to it, the playback rail is the tool. The aesthetic is working late on a hard problem, not opening a tutorial app. Every screen earns its place by getting the user to the visualizer faster and back out cleanly.

The system is dark, tokenised, and built on a 4dp grid. Color is functional, never decorative — five semantic accents map to five jobs (read head, tracking, mutation, verified, pivot), and the same accent pair (12–20% container fill + 30% border) is used everywhere. State is communicated by border pulse + pill, not by a green cell fill alone. Motion is one of three named springs; nothing is linear. The whole product reads as one continuous workspace rather than a stack of cards.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only. The DarkColorScheme is the only scheme. No light-mode override, no warm-sepia reading variant, no auto-theme toggle.
Monospace everywhere. JetBrains Mono at every text role — display, body, code, label. No sans for legibility.
Five functional accents with behavioral names. Each accent has a job (Traversal / Tracking / Mutation / Verified / Pivot) and a paired subtle fill + 30%-alpha border.

Tokenised, never hard-coded. Every color, dp, and animation reads from AlgoTokens; raw Color(0xFF…) and raw *.dp in Modifier.padding are banned outside ui/theme/Color.kt and the visualizer exception list.
State hoisted, regions narrow. VisualizerScreenState is the only state owner; the screen body is declarative.
Playback is IDE-shaped. The transport row is a 32dp rail of circular icon buttons; the canvas is a single well beneath it; the active code line slides in lockstep.
One visualizer family dispatch. VisualizerHost is the only when (family) block; algorithm-specific additions attach as overlays, never as screen-level switches.

rules.name: The Functional-Accent Rule
rules.body: Every accent color has a job. If a use case does not fit one of the five roles (Traversal / Tracking / Mutation / Verified / Pivot), it does not get a new color; it gets the role that fits best, and the inconsistency is fixed at the role level. The two color escapes — Warn Red for error and Data Orange for the data-structure family — are also functional, not decorative.

rules.name: The Paired-Container Rule
rules.body: A subtle accent fill is always paired with a border derived from the same accent at 30% alpha. CyanSubtle ↔ BorderCyan. GreenSubtle ↔ a 30% green border. The fill and the border agree, or the design is wrong.

rules.name: The Color-Is-Never-Only Rule
rules.body: State is communicated by border pulse and pill, not by color alone. Challenge mode uses a pulsing border and a TARGET pill. A green cell fill with no border does not communicate verified.

rules.name: The No-Body-Text-Cyan Rule
rules.body: PrimaryCyan is for borders, fills, and selected accents. It is never used as a body-text color. PurpleGlow is a text color on a PurpleSubtle container; it is never a background.

rules.name: The Monospace-Everywhere Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is the only family. No sans for headings, no serif for emphasis, no system fallback. If a label needs to be more legible, the fix is bigger (move up a step) or darker (move to TextPrimary), not a font swap.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Label Rule
rules.body: Pill / chip / status text is UPPER-CASE; header titles are Title-Case. The two cases carry different jobs: UPPER-CASE reads as a tag, Title-Case reads as a name. Mixing the two on a single element breaks the signal.

rules.name: The 4dp Grid Rule
rules.body: The 4dp grid is strict. The eight space1–space8 tokens (2dp, 4dp, 6dp, 8dp, 12dp, 16dp, 24dp, 32dp) are the only spacing values used. If a design needs 10dp, the components should be merged or split, not the grid broken.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The visual hierarchy is hue + border + subtle fill, not shadow. A drop shadow on a card is almost always wrong; if a surface needs to lift, the fix is glass-elevated + elevationFloating, not a box-shadow.

rules.name: The Traveling-Is-A-State Rule
rules.body: elevationTraveling is only for cells in the middle of a swap-arc flight. It is a state elevation, not a component elevation. Using it on a static cell makes the animation read as this cell is broken.

rules.name: The Two-Surface Rule
rules.body: Nested surfaces must use at least two radius steps apart (e.g. a radiusMd card can contain radiusSm chips, but a radiusMd card containing radiusXs chips looks visually busy). The exception is the segmented toggle inside a chip — that one is intentionally nested close.

dos: Do read the active accent role before picking a color. If the use case does not match a role, change the role, not the color.
Do pair every subtle accent fill with a border from the same accent at 30% alpha. The fill and the border agree.

Do animate using one of the named springs (panelSpring, cellTravelSpring, evalSpring, pointerSpring, lineTrackSpring, liftSpring, settleSpring). The fastest perceptible animation is 100ms (slider drag); the slowest is 600ms (panelSpring). Never linear.
Do honor the 4dp grid. space1 through space8 are the only spacing tokens; if a design needs 10dp, the components are wrong, not the grid.
Do derive every component from AlgoTokens. If you find yourself writing a raw Color(0xFF…) outside ui/theme/Color.kt, stop and add a token.
Do attach per-algorithm gimmicks as VisualizerOverlay (Phase 4) on the AlgorithmSpec. The renderer is never forked.
donts: Don't introduce a gamified learning aesthetic. No XP bars, streak counters, confetti, character avatars, or bright primary-school colors. The user is a developer, not a child.
Don't introduce marketing-style hero sections. No gradient hero, no abstract marketing imagery, no Get started in 30 seconds framing. There is no marketing surface — every screen is a tool.

Don't introduce iOS design language. No Cupertino toggles, no iOS bottom sheets that ignore the system Back gesture, no swiping card stacks. The user is on Android with Material 3 conventions; the system Back gesture and the predictive Back gesture are honored.
Don't add a light-mode path. The dark workspace is the only workspace. DarkColorScheme is the only scheme.
Don't stack two strokeThin borders in place of one strokeActive border. The result reads as a thicker hairline, not as selected.
Don't use PrimaryCyan as a body-text color. It is for borders, fills, and selected accents. PurpleGlow is a text color on a PurpleSubtle container; it is never a background.
Don't place var X by remember { mutableStateOf(...) } inside VisualizerScreen.kt. All visualizer state lives in VisualizerScreenState; the screen body is declarative.
Don't branch on algorithm.name / algorithm.id / algorithm.category inside VisualizerScreen.kt. Per-algorithm behavior is a field on AlgorithmSpec.
